packet_lane_router_rows.reason_from_parent_shelf: OLP and Book of Proof routes are both present; the next non-destructive step is coordinate scanning and attribution routing, not translation.
FCLA and AATA exact-commit cache manifests are present and can support later packet routing after license/attribution checks.
OpenIntro IMS gives a path to public numeracy and data literacy, expanding translation access beyond proof-heavy material.
Packages 147-150 opened the construction method lane; promotion still waits on returns, evidence, or explicit no-construction decisions.
Existing UC04 cache manifests make modality-aware review possible without reducing signed-language work to text-term substitution.

scan_protocol_rows.description: No source route may become an excerpt or adaptation source before exact license, edition, and attribution sidecar requirements are checked.
First pass may count files, identify route type, and record coordinate policy only; it may not copy source prose.
Coordinates can name source paths, ids, pages, line ranges, or categories, but not source definitions, examples, or passages.
Any later selected excerpt requires an attribution or modification notice sidecar before translation or adaptation.
Language-specific or modality-specific promotion requires a dated route/reviewer return.
Signed-language rows remain video-first and cannot be treated as ordinary text-term substitutions.
The semi-constructed lane must preserve no-construction and hold decisions as valid outcomes.

decision: Package 152 routes package 151 source families into coordinate-scan or support-audit paths. It deliberately records no scan results, no license decisions, no source text, no excerpts, no translations, no constructed forms, and no readiness claims.
